title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. Switching off an iron
   B. Playing with matches
   C. Asking an adult to light a fire
   D. Using gloves

2. What is the purpose of skylights? (1 mark)
   A. Let rain in on purpose
   B. Block light
   C. Let daylight through the roof
   D. Make the house hot

3. Which of these parts is found before the stomach? (1 mark)
   A. Gullet
   B. Rectum
   C. Small intestine
   D. Large intestine

4. Which of these can be a solid, liquid or gas depending on conditions? (1 mark)
   A. Stone
   B. Wooden chair
   C. Book
   D. Water

5. Why is air matter? (1 mark)
   A. It has mass and takes up space
   B. It is invisible
   C. It is cold
   D. It is light

6. Which of these is a safety use of light? (1 mark)
   A. Making shadows
   B. Street lights
   C. Colouring paint
   D. Making sound

7. Logs placed under a heavy load help it move because they act as (1 mark)
   A. Weights
   B. Brakes
   C. Rollers
   D. Glue

8. What effect does friction have on rubbing your hands? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them heavy
   B. It makes them warm
   C. It makes them cold
   D. It makes them wet

9. Which of these should be kept away from fire? (1 mark)
   A. Clean water
   B. Paraffin and petrol
   C. Salt
   D. Stones

10. Which waste can be reused as a pencil holder? (1 mark)
   A. Egg shells
   B. An empty tin
   C. Old leaves
   D. Banana peel

11. Why do matches light when rubbed on the box? (1 mark)
   A. Friction makes heat
   B. Wind makes fire
   C. Gravity makes light
   D. Friction makes cold

12. Which use of heat helps farmers to store maize? (1 mark)
   A. Making shadows
   B. Writing
   C. Drying grain
   D. Colouring paper

13. Which of these animals has a soft body covered by a hard shell? (1 mark)
   A. Snail
   B. Ant
   C. Hen
   D. Goat

14. Which of these is a mammal? (1 mark)
   A. Crocodile
   B. Frog
   C. Cow
   D. Tilapia

15. A pupil wants to make a toy car from waste. Which materials are suitable? (1 mark)
   A. A box and bottle tops
   B. Banana peel and leaves
   C. Fire and paper
   D. Water and air

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how to show that metal passes heat more easily than wood. (3 marks)

17. Define matter and give two examples. (2 marks)

18. Describe how you would do an activity to show gravity. (4 marks)

19. Give three problems caused by friction. (3 marks)

20. Give three examples of how plants respond to changes around them. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Playing with matches
   Matches can start fires.

2. C — Let daylight through the roof
   Skylights are roof openings or sheets that let light in.

3. A — Gullet
   Food passes through the gullet before it reaches the stomach.

4. D — Water
   Water can be ice, liquid water or steam.

5. A — It has mass and takes up space
   Air fills balloons and pushes against things, so it takes up space.

6. B — Street lights
   Street lights help people see at night.

7. C — Rollers
   Rollers reduce friction.

8. B — It makes them warm
   Friction produces heat.

9. B — Paraffin and petrol
   Fuels can burn or explode.

10. B — An empty tin
   A clean tin can be reused.

11. A — Friction makes heat
   Rubbing produces heat.

12. C — Drying grain
   Heat dries wet things.

13. A — Snail
   A snail has a soft body with a shell on its back.

14. C — Cow
   A cow has hair and feeds its calf on milk.

15. A — A box and bottle tops
   A box and bottle tops make a toy car.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Put a metal spoon and a wooden spoon into a cup of warm water. After two minutes touch the top of each. The metal feels warmer so metal passes heat easily.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for set up, 1 mark for observation, 1 mark for conclusion.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matter is anything that has mass and takes up space. Examples: water, stone, air.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for two examples.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Drop a stone and a ball from the same height. Observe that they fall down to the ground. Gravity pulls them down.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for items, 1 mark for dropping, 1 mark for observing downward fall, 1 mark for conclusion.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It wears away shoes and tyres, wastes energy, makes machines hot and slows moving parts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Growing towards light, roots growing down, touch-me-not folding leaves, flowers opening in the day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct example.
